ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Collections
ns2:course.description: Variety of newly developed and advanced topics courses within the field of Collections, intended to augment the existing Information Sciences curricula. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 2 or 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in the same or separate terms, to a maximum of 16 hours, if topics vary.
